detail.longDescription:
PikPak - Private cloud that saves your favorite files conveniently. Supports online photo preview and video playing.

You can forward favorite files to PikPak via Telegram Bot, or save them through system sharing; Then find them in PikPak.
PikPak uses secure backup technology to avoid file loss.

PikPak Highlights:
-Sign up to get 6GB of free private cloud storage, and upgrade to a Premium plan at the lowest price to unlock 10TB of private cloud storage, capable of storing up to 8,000 video files.
-Powerful Telegram Bot: one-click forwarding to save files and links from Telegram.
-Leading acceleration technology for fast saving of all files via cloud transfer.
-Convenient preview of image and video.
-Manage the files in the collection by creating folders.

Install PikPak now and you will have a pleasant file collection and viewing experience. You can sign in with your email address and phone.
If you have any questions about PikPak, please join the official PikPak user group: https://t.me/pikpak_userservice_en; You can also feel free to support@mypikpak.com Feedback to us.

-----------------------------------------------
Auto-Subscription Instructions:
1. User Agreement: https://mypikpak.com/policy/user-agreement
2. Privacy Policy: https://mypikpak.com/policy/privacy-policy
3.PikPak subscription service:
 a.PikPak Premium Monthly.
 b.PikPak Premium Yearly.
4.PikPak subscription price:
 a.Premium Monthly: $10.0/month.
 b.Premium Yearly: $100.99/year.
 c.Other currencies are calculated according to the exchange rate.
5. Payment instructions: After activation, the subscription service will be paid directly through the iTunes account.
6. Automatic renewal: Apple iTunes account will automatically renew and deduct fees according to the type of subscription product within 24 hours before expiration.
7. Turn off the service: If you need to turn off the subscription deduction service, please do so in "Account Settings" at least 24 hours in advance.
